transcript.text: Can you describe some key learning outcomes from your four-week training at the district hospital pharmacy?

I'm a final-year BPharm student in Nashik. My project was a six-week stability test on a herbal cough syrup, using three batches. In my four-week training at a district hospital pharmacy, I observed about 150 prescriptions dispensed every day, and I helped label stock. I noticed how often a patient's choice depended on what was in stock. I want an MBA to learn the business side of pharma, such as pricing and distribution.
